posts.headline: Midjourney V7 Generates Photorealistic Videos Now

slide_1.label: BREAKING
slide_1.title: Midjourney V7: Videos From Text!
slide_1.subtitle: Create stunning photorealistic videos directly from prompts.

slide_2.title: Here's What Happened
slide_2.bullet_1: Midjourney V7 now generates photorealistic videos.
slide_2.bullet_2: From text prompts, directly inside Discord.

slide_3.title: What Is AI Video Generation Anyway?
slide_3.simple_explanation: It's like telling an AI exactly what you want to see, and it creates a video from scratch. No cameras needed, just your words!
slide_3.analogy: Imagine asking an artist to paint a moving picture based on your description.

slide_4.title: Why YOU Should Care
slide_4.impact_statement: This makes pro-level video creation accessible to everyone.
slide_4.for_students: Bring your presentations and projects to life easily.
slide_4.for_employees: Create engaging internal comms or training videos.
slide_4.for_business: Produce marketing videos or product demos fast.

slide_5.title: How It Actually Works
slide_5.step_1: You type a detailed text prompt in Discord.
slide_5.step_2: Midjourney's AI interprets your words and vision.
slide_5.step_3: It then generates a high-quality, photorealistic video.
slide_5.fun_fact: The AI understands context and style from your prompt!

slide_6.title: How YOU Can Use This Today
slide_6.use_case_1: Students: Visualizing complex concepts for school.
slide_6.use_case_2: Employees: Explainer videos for work projects.
slide_6.use_case_3: Businesses: Quick social media ad campaigns.
slide_6.use_case_4: Creators: Short films, music video clips, art projects.

slide_7.title: The Good and The Not-So-Good
slide_7.pro_2: Super easy to use with simple text prompts.
slide_7.con_1: Videos are currently limited to 30 seconds.
slide_7.con_2: Still requires some prompt engineering skill.

slide_8.title: The Bigger Picture
slide_8.context: This launch pushes AI video generation further, making high-quality output available to everyday users, not just experts. It's a huge step for creative freedom.
slide_8.vs_before: Video production needed cameras, studios, editing software.
slide_8.vs_now: Your ideas + text prompt = professional video in minutes.

slide_9.title: Pro Tips to Get Started
slide_9.tip_1: Be super specific with your prompts for best results.
slide_9.tip_2: Experiment with different artistic styles and keywords.
slide_9.tip_3: Use negative prompts to exclude unwanted elements.
slide_9.bonus_tip: Combine with image prompts for consistent visual themes!

slide_10.title: The Bottom Line
slide_10.summary: Midjourney V7 is a game-changer for accessible video creation.
slide_10.cta_question: What's the first video you'll create?
